result.planSummary: Implemented deterministic turn derivation from canonical archive entries, added rebuildable Convex turn-cache primitives, exposed the authenticated `/archive/turns` read surface, and rendered derived turns on the client archive page with story-scoped server/client/Convex coverage.

changedFiles.reason: Added the Story 4 turn derivation service, deterministic grouping algorithm, cache rebuild flow, and paged turn reads.
Implemented durable turn-cache upsert/list Convex functions over the `archiveTurns` projection table.
Registered and decorated the new turn derivation service in app composition.
Extended archive surface state to carry derived turn pages.
Added the client API helper for archive turn reads.
Loaded turn data alongside archive data when bootstrapping the archive page.
Initialized archive surface state with turn data support.
Added the client turns section renderer for stable turn boundaries, provenance, and degraded metadata.
Rendered the derived turns section on the process archive page.
Added Story 4 server coverage for turn derivation, empty archives, provenance, degradation, turn-zero behavior, and stable rebuilds.
Added client rendering coverage for the new archive turns surface.
Added proof that turn-cache projection writes do not mutate canonical archive entries.
Updated archive page client fixtures to satisfy the expanded archive surface contract.
